question: Which of the following is India's first cheetah conservation breeding centre, approved by the Central Zoo Authority (CZA) in 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Banni Grasslands**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Banni Grasslands**, located in the state of **Gujarat, India**, have been approved as the site for India’s first **cheetah conservation breeding centre** in 2024.
 
• The **Banni Grasslands** are recognized as one of the largest grassland ecosystems in India and are located near the Rann of Kutch.
 
• The decision to establish the breeding centre in the **Banni Grasslands** was taken by the **Central Zoo Authority (CZA)**, which oversees the management of zoos and breeding centres in India.
 
• This breeding centre aims to **support and strengthen the population of cheetahs** reintroduced to India after being extinct in the wild in the country for over 70 years.
 
• The Banni Grasslands are ecologically suitable for cheetahs due to their **vast open landscapes, prey availability, and semi-arid climate**, which mimic the natural habitat of cheetahs.<
